scope: Real handleAIChat, native tool dispatcher, vision download/inline transport and model calls. Discord and database are in-process fakes; web search/page content are controlled synthetic fixtures. No real Discord sends, DMs, roles, database mutations or search-engine calls. Public-source HTTP transport is replaced by identical synthetic responses; repository parsing, commit pinning, evidence validation and nested research model calls are real.
routeControl: For forceResearch cases, the first research_topic tool choice is forced so the same backend path is compared; subsequent research and answer completions use the configured model unless forceEmptyResearch is set.
emptyResearchControl: The forceEmptyResearch case returns fixed research planning and zero-findings JSON plus a fixed low-information chat draft. Source search and reading, tool dispatch, report construction and final grounding run in the selected image. This is a deterministic integration regression, not a model-quality measurement.
